from tastypie.resources import ModelResource
from tastypie.authentication import ApiKeyAuthentication
from tastypie.authorization import Authorization
from .models import CustomerBillingInvoice

class CustomerInvoiceResource(ModelResource):
    class Meta:
        queryset = CustomerBillingInvoice.objects.all()
        resource_name = 'invoices'
        # Insecure: default Authorization allows any valid API key holder full access to all objects
        authentication = ApiKeyAuthentication()
        authorization = Authorization()
diagnosis: CustomerInvoiceResource configures tastypie.authorization.Authorization(), which is a completely permissive authorization class. While ApiKeyAuthentication requires a valid user API key, Authorization() allows any authenticated user to view, edit, or delete CustomerBillingInvoice records belonging to any other customer across the entire system.
